item.title: Michael (Mike) Free - Glastonbury Town Council
item.description: Glastonbury Town Council is deeply saddened to learn of the passing of former Mayor Michael (Mike) Free. Mike served the town with dedication & distinction, holding the office of Mayor of Glastonbury twice in 1989 and 1995. item.title: Glastonbury Town Council Approves Ambitious 2026–27 Budget - Glastonbury Town Council
item.description: Glastonbury Town Council has approved its 2026–27 budget and precept, setting out a bold and community-focused plan that protects essential services, supports local culture, and invests in Glastonbury’s future - while keeping the impact on households as low as possible.

item.title: Living Brue Day - Glastonbury Town Council
item.description: This free event will celebrate the River Brue, raise awareness and foster action on critical water issues facing our local ecosystems. Experts will delve into water remediation projects, sharing innovative solutions for restoring balance to our rivers and wetlands.

item.title: Glastonbury TrainLink Public Meeting on Monday March 9th 4-7pm in the Festival Hall - Glastonbury Town Council
item.description: A public meeting to learn about the campaign for direct bus link for local residents and visitors to our nearest railway station, Castle Cary. Monday 9th March 4-7pm in Glastonbury Council's Festival Hall.

item.title: Glastonbury World Heritage Status: Public Working Group and Consultant Scoping Study Published - Glastonbury Town Council
item.description: Glastonbury Town Council has released the report prepared by its Public Working Group alongside an independent consultant’s scoping study exploring the potential for Glastonbury to seek UNESCO World Heritage Status.
